title: Incidents where Police Have Been Challenged by Disorderly Member of Public
what_it_is: Incidents where Police Have Been Challenged by Disorderly Member of Public

sections.label: Police handling disorderly public incidents
sections.summary: The reply states incidents of officers challenged by disorderly public, that back-up deployment numbers are not tracked, and how police are trained for face-to-face conflicts.

sentences.text: The following question stood in the name of  Miss Cheng Li Hui –  1 To ask the Minister for Home Affairs (a) how many incidents have there been in the past two years of uniformed police being challenged by a disorderly member of the public; (b) in how many of these cases was additional back-up deployed; and (c) how does the Ministry ensure Police personnel are physically and mentally prepared to handle face-to-face conflicts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These include incidents where officers were challenged by disorderly members of the public.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We do not track the number of cases where back-up officers were deployed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Depending on the situation, additional resources may be despatched to reinforce the on-scene officers to arrest the criminals, maintain peace and protect lives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police officers are trained in a range of techniques to handle dynamic and unpredictable threats that they may encounter, including face-to-face conflicts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: These include the use of verbal command, unarmed tactics, batons, tasers and firearms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Tan) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police officers will evaluate the threat posed and take an appropriate course of action against the aggressor, taking into consideration public safety and their own safety and the aggressor’s safety as well.

sections.label: Support for injured police officers
sections.summary: The passage states that injured officers are taken care of by the Police through medical and personal recourse, and support in their duties continues.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: When they are injured in the course of their duty, which can happen from time to time, they would be taken care of by the Police in terms of the medical as well as personal recourse, in terms of how they are being taken care of in the Police Force.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
sentences.text: More importantly, we will also continue to support them in their duties which is what they signed up for.
